(kha)༄༅/ /shes rab kyi lha rnams kyi rjes gnang skabs su gleng bar 'os pa'i gtam nyung ngu bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti

tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// shes rab kyi lha rnams kyi rjes gnang skabs su gleng bar 'os pa'i gtam nyung ngu bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhi/ gzungs dang spobs pa'i dngos grub kyis// srid zhi'i phan bde rgyas mdzad pa// blo gros mchog stsol lhag pa'i lhar// btud nas bdud rtsi'i dbyangs snyan len// de la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i skor gyi rjes su gnang ba'i skabs mtshams sbyor gyi bshad pa cung zad spro na/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod gsal gdab pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas 'di ltar gleng bar bya ste/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa// gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na// g.yang sar lhung ba'i gzhan dbang 'jigs 'gyur ba// de la phyi nas gang gis bslang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ yang dag pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bzung zhing*/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo tshang la ma nor bar yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang gis rang ma bslus par dal 'byor la snying po len pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos/ de lta bu'i chos rnam par dag pa bsgrub pa la'ang*/ rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rin chen phreng ba las/ 'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste// 'di sngon 'gro ba dad pa yin// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang 'di ltar skyes bu chung ngu'i dbang du byas na/ rnyed par dka' ba'i dal ba long med pas myur du 'jig cing*/ shi nas cang med du mi 'gro bar las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams la/

de'i tshe ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal bzod blags med pa myong ba'i tshul legs par rtogs te/ mngon mtho lha mi'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba'ang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa zhig la rags las/ skyes bu 'bring gi dbang du byas na/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin me 'obs lta bur shes nas/ rang nyid kho na zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i bsam pas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung la thug cing*/ de la'ang las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis las/ las kyi kun 'byung rkyang pa tsam gyis 'khor bar 'phen mi nus te/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ srid pa'i sred las rnam brgal ba'i// las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te// lhan cig byed pa zad phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ni nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung dang*/ de'i rtsa ba'ang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ma rig pa kho na yin la/ de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can bskyed nas srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod dgos pa'ang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la rags las/ skyes bu chen po'i dbang du byas na/ spyir skye ba snga ma yod par bsgrub pa'i rig pas sems can thams cad mar shes pa dang*/ drin dran pa dang*/ drin bzo ba dang*/ yid 'ong gi byams pa dang*/ snying rje rnams kyi rgyu la brten nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas drangs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du phyin drug gi bya ba la dngos su sbyor ba 'jug pa sems bskyed de/ de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras 'brel pa can gyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba'ang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa zhig la rags las/ bye brag tu rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad gcig tu bsdoms nas phar phyin drug gi nyams len gyi nang du 'du bas/

sbyin sogs thabs kyi phyogs bzhi dang*/ gnyis ka'i grogs su gces pa brtson 'grus te lnga po'ang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas ma zin na thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba yin te/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// dmigs bu med par byang chub reg par nus ma yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na dge ba'i rtsa ba che chung ji lta bu zhig yin kyang rung ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dri ma med pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa kho na la ltos dgos te/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam la slob pa'i dbang du byas na/ slob dpon chen po kṛ pi ta ka ma las khyad chos bzhi gsungs pa'i nang tshan/ dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas te// zhes gsungs pa ltar rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi theg pa ni/ mtha' drug dang tshul bzhis rgyas btab pa'i gsang ba chen po'i gnas rnams la ji bzhin dpyod par nus pa'i dbang po rnon po kho na'i ngo skal du bstan pa'i phyir na shes rab phun sum tshogs pa zhig la rags las pas mtshon/ mdor na slob dpon 'phags pa lhas dbu ma bzhi brgya pa las/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan ni// kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab ste// zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon sum tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa mthong ba ste shes bya mngon gyur dang*/ rjes su dpag pa dang*/ lung tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa ma mthong ba ste shes bya lkog gyur dang shin tu lkog gyur gyi yon tan mtha' dag gi rtsa ba ni shes rab phun sum tshogs pa zhig la rags las shing*/ de lta bu'i shes rab kyi nyer len tsam rang gi steng nas grub pa zhig yin mod kyang*/ de myur du sad par byed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen ni lhag pa'i lha khyad par can gyi byin rlabs zhig la nges par brten dgos shing*/

de la'ang rgyud sde chen po rnam pa bzhi nas shes rab kyi lha'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad la nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags pa ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can ma gnyis yin la/ de las kyang 'dir skabs su babs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku can rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las dkyil 'khor yi gtso bo dang*/ 'khor gyi tshul du bstan pa'i bsgrub bya'i lha dang*/ sgrub byed kyi thabs dang*/ rig pa'i sngags kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtha' klas pa zhig gsungs pa la brten nas mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyis legs par bkral ba'i bka' srol zab cing rgya che ba du ma zhig bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ zhes pa'i mtshams so so'i lo rgyus kyi khyad par sbyar te/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser la mtshon na/ khyad par du gyur pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du 'bul na/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub dbang po dzai tā ri zhes grags pa'i mtshan gyi zla snang 'jig rten na ches cher gsal ba des rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mngon sum du bzhes te rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal la gnang*/ des rdo rje gdan pa chung ba don yod rdo rje la gnang*/ de las gsan te gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir snying rje chen po bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis spyan drangs shing*/ 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la gnang ba yin te/

de'ang rje btsun sa skya pa chen po nyid dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i gsung gis/ nyid pha jo sras sa skya pa dkon mchog rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 'gran zla dang bral ba de tsam gyi bu yin pas slob gnyer gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig byed dgos/ slob gnyer byed pa la shes rab thogs pa med pa zhig dgos/ shes rab kyi lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin pas 'di sgrubs shig gsungs nas 'di'i rjes su gnang ba dang gdams ngag gi skor thams cad gnang zhing*/ bla mas kyang sgrub grogs mdzad de bsgrubs pas/ thog mar bar chad kyi ltas cung zad byung ba la/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i srung ba la sogs pa mdzad pas mi g.yo ba'i zhal gzigs shing bar chad bzlog de nas zla ba drug song ba'i tshe/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'grub nas zhal mngon sum du gzigs te/ de'ang mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa nye bar bkod pa'i dbus su nor bu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri'i steng na/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthe mdzub kyis yu ba bzung nas g.yas g.yon du gyes te snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i utpala'i steng na ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yon pa'i sor mos g.yas pa'i sor mo cung zad mnan pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas bklubs pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu bkra ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ 'od zer gyi drwa ba phyogs bcur bres pa/ g.yas su blo gros mi zad pa/ g.yon du spobs pa brtsegs pa ste 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang bcas pa mngon sum du byon te gtso bo 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min// khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min// bdag don la zhen na byang sems min// 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min// zhes zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi gnad thams cad rdzogs par thugs la 'khrungs/

shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing chos thams cad thugs su chud/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa brnyes/ de phyin chad mjal nam bzhed pa'i dus su gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis zhal ston cing chos gsung ba dang the tshom gcod pa yin gsungs/ des rigs kyi sras slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis la gnang ste/ de gnyis kyis kyang yang dang yang du zhal gzigs/ rje btsun rin po che'i drung du chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos gsan te/ des kyang 'bral med du zhal gzigs/ de'i drung du 'phags pa rin po ches gsan te/ des kyang yang yang zhal gzigs/ yang chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i drung du rong pa ā ka ras gsan pa sogs nas rim par brgyud de byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyis dngos dang*/ nyams dang*/ mnal lam gyi tshul du zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gis lhag pa'i lha mchog tu bzung ba'i yi dam khyad par can 'di'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la zhes sogs rjes gnang gi dkyus ltar ro// ༈ /yang 'jam dbyangs smra seng skabs/ bzhugs pa'i nang tshan zhes pa yan gong ltar la/ khyad par du gyur pa 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du gsol na/ 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta zhes pa la gnang*/ des bram ze rig byed gzhon nu la gnang ste/ de'ang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dbus su bram ze swa sti bha dra ste bde legs bzang po zhes pa lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu lon pa zhig 'khor ba la yid skyo zhing sangs rgyas pa la dad pa skyes te/ su ma ti kīrti zhes pa legs pa'i blo gros grags pa'i rtsar yi ge slob tu song bas/

yon bdag rgyal po ku mā ra de ba na re/ lo dgu bcu lon pa'i yi ge mi lob zer bas/ de bden yi ge ma lob na chos klog mi shes/ chos ma klog na chos byed mi shes/ chos byed ma shes na 'khor bar mi spong zhing sangs rgyas mi thob/ de bas na 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gsol ba gdab dgos snyam nas/ sgrub thabs 'di nyid drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta las nod de/ dus ji tsam zhig gis 'grub zhus pas/ las 'phro yod na nyi ma gcig gis kyang 'grub gsung*/ der swa sti bha dras 'phags pa'i sku zhig gi mdun du ral gri drangs te/ 'phags pa/ do nub chos mi gsung*/ zhal mi ston na ske bcad de 'chi byas nas sa rde btsugs pas nam langs pa na 'phags pa byon nas chos gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs pas lo brgyad lon pa tsam du gyur te bram ze'i paṇḍi ta chen po rig byed gzhon nu zhes grags so// des

gsan yig phal cher du bar 'dir dbyangs can bzang po zhes byung na'ang*/ lo rgyus yig rnying rnams las dam pas rig byed gzhon nu dngos las gsan par bshad do// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub pa mchog gi ded dpon dam pa sangs rgyas zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi yul lho phyogs bai ta'i gling tsa ra siṃ har sku 'khrungs/ thugs dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhal gzigs/ grub thob thams cad kyis gdams pa'i mdzod byin/ rten 'brel dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon shes mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mngon sum du brnyes pa rje btsun dam pa rgya gar zhes 'jig rten na nyi zla ltar grags pa de la gnang ba dang*/ nye brgyud pha dam pa sangs rgyas nyid kyis rje btsun smra ba'i seng ge las dngos su gsan pas na thugs dam rgyun 'khyer bde gshegs bcu gnyis kyi nang nas kyang ngo mtshar che shos shig tu snang ngo zhes bla ma gong ma dag gis gsungs so// de ltar na grub chen ka ma la shī la ste padma'i ngang tshul lam 'gro ba'i mgon po dam pa sangs rgyas nas bzung bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po'i bar lam 'di las dngos grub brnyes pa'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub nas sogs sbrel/ des mtshon 'jam dbyangs dkar po ma ti lugs dang*/ shes rab 'khor lo sogs kyi lo rgyus so so'i rjes gnang las 'byung ba ltar sbrel lo// ༈ /lha mo dbyangs can ma'i skabs/ paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī'i lugs kyi dbyangs can dkar mo la mtshon na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma gnyis yin la/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar la/ de la 'dir skabs su babs pa/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i shes rab kyi lha thun mong du gyur pa lha mo dbyangs can ma ste/ de la'ang rig byed kyi gtam rgyud las 'byung ba ltar na/ sngon gyi tshe tshangs pa chen po'i zhal las chu'i phung po zhig byung ba 'dzam gling gi lho phyogs su 'khyil pa la yid kyi rol mtsho zhes grags shing*/

de las rba rlabs kyi gdangs las swa ra swa tī zhes pa'i dbyangs snyan phun sum tshogs pa zhig byung ba ni yum dang*/ tshangs pa chen po de la chags pa'i thugs kyis gsan pa yab kyi dod du byas te/ rgya mtsho de lo stong du bsrubs pa'i snying po las lha mo mtshar sdug dang ldan pa zhig byung ba na lha mo dbyangs can ma zhes grags la/ deng sang yang gnas der dri za tumbu ru'i chung ma'i tshul du mdzad nas bzhugs par bshad de/ bram ze phur bus/ biṣṇu'i gzugs can tumbu ru la dga' bskyed tshul 'dzin ma/ zhes gsungs/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal gyi mche ba'i rtse las sprul par bshad cing*/ de dang mthun par bram ze phur bus kyang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal gyi mche ba'i rtse las mngon sprul zhing*// zhes gsungs/ don dam par sras dang bcas pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi shes rab stong pa nyid bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i rnam rol du shar ba ste/ de lta bu'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can 'di nyid la'ang sgrub skor mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod de/ bram ze phur bu nas rim par brgyud de sum pa lo tsā bas bod du dar bar mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo bram ze phur bu'i lugs dang*/ bo dong paṇḍi ta phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes lha mo nyid kyis dngos su zhal gzigs te spobs pa'i gter mdzod chen po grol nas de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos pusti brgya phrag thal ba gsung rtsom gnang ba de las brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo bo dong lugs dang*/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs te kha che paṇḍi ta chen po bikṣa par ma sogs nas nye bar brgyud cing zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa shin tu zab pa dbyangs can dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi skor dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho sogs nas 'byung bas mtshon gdams skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa'i nang nas da lan gyi skabs su babs pa ni/

'phags ma nyid kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po sa manta shrī la gnang*/ des rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī dzñā na bha dra mu nīnd+ra la gnang*/ de nyid chen po hor gyis gdan drangs te bod du byon nas zhwa lu tshong dus phebs pa na/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal spyan 'dren pa la ched gtad du mngags kyang hor gyis bkag nas phebs ma thub/ de'i tshe bu ston rin po ches slar yang thugs sras lo tsā ba la sgra tshad dang rgyud sde'i skor gyi dri ba 'ga' dang bcas te/ gdams pa zab mo 'dra 'dug na'ang nyon shog ces bka' bsgos te ched du mngags/ thugs sras lo tsā ba chen pos kyang dogs pa gcod pa'i dri ba thams cad mthil phyin par mdzad cing*/ khyad par du dbyangs can ma'i sgrub skor 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa gsan te/ zhag nyer gcig tsam bsgrubs pas pi wang gi sgra dngos su gsan nas mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol/ gzhan yang phyis su tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos zhag bdun du sgrub pa mdzad pas me tog dkar po'i char babs shing dngos su zhal gzigs te snyan dngags kyi rtsom pa thogs med du gyur/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos bsgrubs pas kyang zhal dngos su bstan te ja sbyor re'i yun la shlo ka brgya re tsam zin pa'i thugs rab phun sum tshogs par byung zhing*/ rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad la 'gran zla spangs pa'i snyan dngags mkhan chen por gyur pa sogs rang gzhan gyi bla ma gong ma thams cad kyi thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/ grub pa brnyes pa sha stag byung ba'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa'i rjes gnang zab mo 'bul ba la/ slob dpon gyis bya ba dang sogs dkyus bzhin spel bas mtshon rang rang gi lo rgyus sbyar ro// dpyid kyis bzung ba'i gzhan gsos glus// yid can snying la dga' ster bzhin// mkhas pa'i legs gsung bdud rtsi'i dbyangs// thar 'dod rna bar snyan gyur cig

/ces pa'ang rje bla ma bcu phrag rig pa'i mahā paṇḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dpal bzang pos 'og min gnyis pa shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi bla brang thar pa rtser gsung bshad ji ltar gnang ba bzhin yi ger bris shig ces mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyi zhal snga nas bka' stsal rin po che'i me tog spyi bor phebs pa gus pas mchod de/ skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis zin bris su btab pa las/ slar yang yig rnying las 'byung ba'i lo rgyus le tshan kyang bsnan te bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ //sarba dā pra dzñā lakṣ+mīṃ pra bardhantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
